name: Condoriri lake and base camp
why: Up a valley of llamas and grazing alpacas to the Chiar Khota lake under the Condoriri, a peak shaped like a condor with open wings.
book: Community fee at Tuni. Transport from La Paz to the Tuni dam (2 h).
dangers: Altitude: La Paz is at 3,600 m; spend two or three days there before any hike.

points.name: Tuni
points.note: A reservoir on the Altiplano at 4,400 m.

points.name: Laguna Chiar Khota
points.note: A lake at 4,650 m under the glaciers of Condoriri.
